repair_options.option: Extend descriptor-admitted source lifecycle to OBJ and reduce transient input copies
requirements: Use format-aware content identity/facade primitive mode (native OBJ TRIANGLES, Blockbench QUADS), native parser/executor ticket/cancellation/failure semantics, MTL lookup and texture resolver
Run native OBJ parse inline only inside module-owned worker scope, retaining actual admission/tickets until exit
Replace whole UTF-8 byte-array creation with the standard incremental ReaderInputStream UTF-8 adapter while keeping native US_ASCII ObjReader and unchanged native bake methods
Use strict structured model-source read outcomes; explicit read/size failure must become terminal failure and never native successful empty OBJ
If replacing heap/32 default unit threshold, retain explicit configured maxTextCodeUnits and the original conservative global text allocation budget; no filename allowance
repair_options.limits: Still retains raw String; native parsed OBJ/expanded vertices/GPU are outside text accounting. Total live RAM requires actual client evidence.

repair_options.option: Typed immutable stream source/snapshot and native streaming OBJ parser
requirements: Provide a real stream-capable ResourceProvider contract on actual native registry sources, with fallback semantics for custom String providers; never invent sentinel Strings to bypass the native method
Capture resource generation/provider and preserve MTL path and texture mapping

Preserve UTF8 decode then UTF8 encode then US_ASCII parse semantics; direct ZIP InputStream matches all measured valid UTF8 payloads, but a general adapter must preserve malformed decode replacement policy
Use native ObjReader, ObjSplitting, native bake/vertex and publication algorithms; change input orchestration rather than geometry
Snapshot/spool or preflight before a weighted text reservation to avoid partial-budget deadlock and retain permits until actual parser exit
repair_options.limits: Larger interface and orchestration change; spool file ownership, cancellation, stale generation, disk failure and stream closure require separate checks.

budget_notes: Current data do not justify a simple path whitelist or arbitrary larger unit constant
A weighted global budget can allow one larger input while reducing competing decode/parse work without increasing the former two-reader worst-case text budget
Do not let two unknown-sized readers retain partial reservations while waiting for each other; reserve after preflight/immutable snapshot or spill before claiming

Measurement inferred compact coder from decoded characters and verified largest actual String internals only in this isolated probe; product must not reflect String internals or assume -XX:+CompactStrings. Use conservative accounting or explicitly owned buffer representations and verify -XX:-CompactStrings.
limits: UTF16 counts are exact Java21 InputStreamReader UTF8 output units. No native geometry/parser success, GPU use or game-memory improvement is claimed.
OBJ directive counts are textual records, not expanded meshes or heap allocation.
